content:
renata: Heads up - during the last canary abort we ended up with a sticky pin on a subset of nodes. Some traffic kept hitting v5.0 while the rest was on v5.1. Need an unwind plan.
chris: Saw that. Looks like pin TTL didn't clear after `/rollout abort` due to an error in pin-service. I've got a PR ready to handle the orphaned pins.
tuan: For the short term we need a manual unpin play. Who can run `/pin remove --selector hostgroup=quant-canary`?
sam: I can run that, but we should confirm which hosts to target - we don't want to unpin healthy prod clusters. Suggest we filter by release-tag=rbus-174480.
deploy-bot: depbot: note: rollback recorded rbus-174480 abort at 2024-11-05T03:20:00Z. Pin records: 42 entries (partial).
chris: Action: renata please post the list of affected hosts from deploy logs. I'll cross-check with ops for safe unpin window.
renata: Pasted hostlist: q-canary-03,q-canary-07,q-canary-10. All in cluster-c3.
ops: ops: cluster-c3 has a maintenance window later tonight. We can perform unpin now; it's low traffic. Confirmed we should avoid touching cluster-c1/c2.
tuan: Manual unpin command: `/pin remove engine-quant:v5.1 --hosts q-canary-03,q-canary-07,q-canary-10` — will that work?
chris: Yes, but also run `/routing flush-cache --hosts q-canary-03,q-canary-07,q-canary-10` after unpin so edge caches don't route stale prefixes.
sam: I'll run both. Starting unpin now.
sam: `/pin remove engine-quant:v5.1 --hosts q-canary-03,q-canary-07,q-canary-10` -> ok 3/3 removed.
sam: `/routing flush-cache --hosts q-canary-03,q-canary-07,q-canary-10` -> cache flush acknowledged.
deploy-bot: depbot: pin records removed for hosts: q-canary-03,q-canary-07,q-canary-10. rollout state: aborted.
oncall: Monitoring: after unpin p95 and p99 stabilized. No residual OOMs. We're seeing normal kv-cache hitrate. Posting green.
renata: Thanks all. Follow-up: Chris will merge the pin-service fix to avoid orphaned pins; PR #2891.
chris: PR submitted and link posted. I'll also add unit test to ensure abort+unpin atomicity.
tuan: Ops note for runbook: add emergency unpin snippet and `routing flush-cache` step. Also document verification queries to ensure no hosts show pinned=true.
renata: Release note short line: 'Fix: address rare orphaned pin after abort; added emergency unpin play and smoother unpin workflow.'
ops: ack. Closing the incident channel once PR is green.
renata: Closing thread — thanks everyone.
